name: Ocean
description: Open water that stretches toward the horizon. Watch out for drowned.

name: Deep Ocean
description: Past the continental shelf, the seafloor drops away into darkness.

name: Warm Ocean
description: Clear tropical water with coral reefs and pufferfish.

name: Lukewarm Ocean
description: Mild coastal water where tropical fish drift in from the south.

name: Deep Lukewarm Ocean
description: Deep, mild water with ocean monuments somewhere below.

name: Cold Ocean
description: Chilly water fed by northern currents. Salmon run here.

name: Deep Cold Ocean
description: Cold, dark depths off the continental shelf.

name: Frozen Ocean
description: Sea ice and icebergs where polar bears roam.

name: Deep Frozen Ocean
description: Deep Arctic water capped with drifting pack ice.

name: River
description: Rivers and lakes that carve through the land. Squid and salmon live here.

name: Frozen River
description: Lakes and rivers frozen solid for much of the year.

name: Beach
description: Sandy shores where turtles lay their eggs.

name: Snowy Beach
description: A cold, snow-dusted shoreline.

name: Stony Shore
description: Rocky cliffs where the land meets the sea.

name: Plains
description: Flat grassland and farmland. Villages and horses are common.

name: Sunflower Plains
description: Tallgrass prairie dotted with sunflowers.

name: Snowy Plains
description: Open tundra covered in snow. Strays wander at night.

name: Ice Spikes
description: Glaciers and packed ice rising from the snow.

name: Desert
description: Endless sand and cacti. Desert temples hide below.

name: Badlands
description: Bands of colorful terracotta mesas and red sand.

name: Eroded Badlands
description: Terracotta canyons and hoodoos carved by erosion.

name: Wooded Badlands
description: Mesa tops dotted with scrubby oak trees.

name: Savanna
description: Warm, dry grassland with scattered acacia trees.

name: Savanna Plateau
description: Raised savanna tablelands with wooded hills.

name: Windswept Savanna
description: Steep, jumbled savanna terrain shaped by the wind.

name: Forest
description: Dense oak and birch woodland.

name: Flower Forest
description: Woodland carpeted in wildflowers. Bees love it here.

name: Birch Forest
description: Pale birch trees with bright leaves.

name: Dark Forest
description: A closed canopy of dark oak. Woodland mansions lurk here.

name: Taiga
description: Cool spruce forest where wolves and foxes roam.

name: Old Growth Pine Taiga
description: Towering pines over podzol and mossy boulders.

name: Old Growth Spruce Taiga
description: Giant spruce in damp rainforest.

name: Snowy Taiga
description: Snow-laden boreal forest.

name: Grove
description: Snowy spruce forest on high mountain slopes.

name: Swamp
description: Murky wetland with lily pads and slimes.

name: Mangrove Swamp
description: Tangled mangrove roots rising from mud.

name: Jungle
description: Lush, wet rainforest with parrots and ocelots.

name: Sparse Jungle
description: A thinner, sunnier fringe of jungle.

name: Bamboo Jungle
description: Very rainy jungle full of bamboo groves. Pandas welcome.

name: Windswept Hills
description: Rugged, wind-blasted hills with exposed stone and emerald ore.

name: Windswept Gravelly Hills
description: Barren, gravel-strewn hills.

name: Windswept Forest
description: Steep, wooded hills.

name: Meadow
description: High alpine grassland full of flowers below the peaks.

name: Snowy Slopes
description: Snow-covered mountainsides with powder snow traps.

name: Frozen Peaks
description: Icy summits capped with glaciers and packed ice.

name: Jagged Peaks
description: Sharp, snowy mountain spires. Goats climb here.

name: Stony Peaks
description: Bare rocky summits above the treeline.

name: Mushroom Fields
description: A rare mycelium island. Hostile mobs never spawn here.
